name: clink-cli-vendored
description: Vendored single-file bundle of @clink-ai/clink-cli (../../../clink-cli). playwright stays external: it is an optional runtime fallback loaded through a guarded dynamic import, and bundling it pulls in unresolvable chromium-bidi/fsevents natives. Re-vendor from the clink-cli source dir: cd <repo>/clink-cli && npm run build && npx --no-install esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:playwright --outfile=../agentic-payment-skills/vendor/clink-cli/clink-cli.bundle.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);"
